new_value: Stale: all four claims contradict the current tree. (1) to_option no longer treats 0x80 as parent-presence: dao_types.py:87 emits 0x80 only when self.external is set (parent always encoded per non-storing profile). (2) from_option parses the parent unconditionally (dao_types.py:97-102, Data Length 20 required). (3) external is reported from the wire bit (dao_types.py:101), not forced False. (4) dao_origin_signature.json: 49 transit options scanned, all 48 valid cases encode flags=0x00; only the designated negative reject_unsupported_transit_e encodes 0x80, and the DaoOriginValidator rejects it as UNSUPPORTED_TRANSIT_E (spec/05 8.7). Verified: pytest test_dao_origin.py -k 'e_flag or external or transit' 5 pass; test_dao_prefix_authorization.py 1 pass; test_vectors.py -k dao_origin 106 pass (project venv).
